Canny


FEEDBACK CAPTURE



Turn conversations into triaged feature requests



Hi there,




Customer conversations contain product requests. The work begins when someone has to read the call, ticket, or review, isolate each request, spot duplicates, and send it for triage.




Canny is customer feedback management software. Connect Intercom, Zendesk, Freshdesk, Gong, or Zoom, and Autopilot reads the source, extracts feature requests, merges detected duplicates, and triages the feedback to the right team.




Your product team gets the extracted request instead of a full conversation waiting to be processed. Autopilot handles capture, deduplication, and triage across every Canny plan.




Start on the $0 Free plan, which includes 25 tracked users—users associated with feedback. Connect one supported source, then review the requests Autopilot extracts and merges to judge whether the workflow fits your team.



 


Start free and connect one source



- Canny
